description: This is a Java interface defining generic service operations for managing entities in a sales management system, including CRUD operations, refresh, count, and session management methods.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityService
classes.description: A generic service interface providing standard CRUD operations and transaction management for entities extending SalesManagerEntity.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a new entity in the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing entity in the database.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and persists an entity in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes an entity from the database.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the entity state from the database.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by its identifier.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all entities.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by class and identifier.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of entities.
